;;;591        if ((g_fw_ctx.state == FW_UPDATE_READY || g_fw_ctx.state == FW_UPDATE_TRANSFERRING) &&
;;;592            (tickTimer_GetCount() - g_fw_ctx.last_block_tick >= FW_TRANSFER_TIMEOUT_MS))
;;;593        {

;;;595                     FW_TRANSFER_TIMEOUT_MS);

;;;598        }
;;;599    
;;;600        // 当前方案中，擦除和写入都在34/36服务中实时完成
;;;601        // Task函数主要用于兼容性，可以执行一些后台检查
;;;602        switch (g_fw_ctx.state)
;;;603        {
;;;604            case FW_UPDATE_VERIFYING:
;;;605                // 已由OnTransferExit直接处理，此状态不再使用

                  fw_erase_range PROC
;;;146     */
;;;147    static FlashDownloadResult_t fw_erase_range(uint32_t start_addr, uint32_t end_addr)
000000  e92d4ff3          PUSH     {r0,r1,r4-r11,lr}
;;;148    {
000004  b081              SUB      sp,sp,#4
000006  468a              MOV      r10,r1
;;;149        if (g_fw_ctx.flash_handle == NULL) {
000008  482a              LDR      r0,|L18.180|

;;;150            return FW_RESULT_NOT_READY;
00000e  2008              MOVS     r0,#8
                  |L18.16|
;;;151        }
;;;152        
;;;153        uint32_t sector_size = g_fw_ctx.config.flash_sector_size;
;;;154        uint32_t start_sector = fw_get_sector_start(start_addr);
;;;155        uint32_t end_sector = fw_get_sector_start(end_addr);
;;;156        uint32_t erased_count = 0;
;;;157        uint32_t skipped_count = 0;
;;;158        
;;;159        FW_LOG_I("Erasing range: 0x%08X - 0x%08X", start_sector, end_sector);
;;;160        
;;;161        for (uint32_t sector_addr = start_sector; sector_addr <= end_sector; sector_addr += sector_size) {
